**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

Section 28 hits the playbook's preferred position exactly:
- **§28.1** — governing law is the State of New York (with CISG disclaimed).
- **§28.2** — exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts of New York County, with irrevocable submission and venue/forum objection waivers.
- A document-wide search for "arbitration" returned no results, so there is no mandatory or foreign-seated arbitration to displace the courts.

Two ancillary mechanics are mutual and customary, and do not affect classification: the §28.2 carve-out permitting either party to seek temporary injunctive relief elsewhere to protect confidential information or IP, and the §28.3 pre-filing executive escalation (fifteen business days, expressly not delaying urgent relief or limitations-period filings).
